research_question: Is the net retrieval value of materializing a high-fidelity Omni representation sparse, signed, and predictable from build-time or historical-workload signals above a BM25 plus ColSmol base index?

unit.reason: The current ViDoRe artifacts provide page images and page OCR text but no original PDF, layout boxes, or region labels.

retrieval.singleton_value: Mean workload nDCG@10 change when exactly one page's complete-index Omni rank contribution is added to the frozen base RRF route.
retrieval.warning: Singleton values identify first-order benefit and harm; they do not assume additivity and do not replace the interference-aware greedy oracle.

gate.predictability_is_diagnostic_only: Do not stop before multivariate cross-domain prediction merely because a single feature AUC is weak.

information_boundary.future_qrels_and_omni_ranks: Used only to construct oracle labels and evaluate headroom; forbidden to a deployable build-time selector.
information_boundary.held_out_requirement: Any learned materialization policy must later be frozen and tested on a new domain or time-aligned workload.
